info.label: Reservation availability
info.value:
Reservation only
We kindly ask everyone to start their meal at the same time. It would be helpful if you could arrive about 10 minutes before your reservation time. The estimated dining time is between 2.5 to 3 hours.
Children aged 12 and over are requested to order the same course meal as adults. Due to the structure of the building, we ask that you refrain from moving seats or stepping outside during your meal. Please note that we do not have facilities for breastfeeding, diaper changing, or children's chairs.
